SELECT u.full_name, t.user_id, t.created_at, t.amount, t.instrument, t.status, t.flag_reason, t.payment_method, t.external_ref, t.ip_address, t.processed_at, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id AND t2.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) AS transaction_count, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id AND t2.instrument LIKE '%HIGH%' AND t2.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) AS high_risk_instrument_count, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id AND t2.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) AS total_volume, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id AND t2.instrument LIKE '%HIGH%' AND t2.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) * 100 / 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id AND t2.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) AS high_risk_instrument_percentage
FROM users u JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE UPPER(u.risk_level) = 'HIGH' AND (u.kyc_status = 'UNVERIFIED' OR u.kyc_expiry_date >= date('now', '-30 days')) AND 
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id AND t2.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) > 35 AND 
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id AND t2.instrument LIKE '%HIGH%' AND t2.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) * 100 / 
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id AND t2.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) > 30;

detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
WHERE UPPER(u.risk_level) IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') 
AND UPPER(t.instrument) IN ('CRYPTO', 'FOREX') 
AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-60 days') 
AND u.user_id IN (SELECT user_id 
                   FROM (SELECT user_id, instrument, amount_usd, 
                                SUM(CASE WHEN instrument = 'AMZN' THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS amzn, 
                                SUM(CASE WHEN instrument = 'GOOG' THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS goog 
                                FROM transactions 
                                WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') 
                                GROUP BY user_id, instrument) 
                   GROUP BY user_id 
                   HAVING STDDEV(amount_usd) > 0 
                   AND (SUM(CASE WHEN instrument IN ('AMZN', 'GOOG') THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(amount_usd)) > 0.25 
                   AND COUNT(DISTINCT instrument) >= 3) 
AND u.user_id IN (SELECT user_id 
                   FROM (SELECT user_id, COUNT(txn_id) AS txn_count, 
                                COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(created_at)) AS day_count 
                                FROM transactions 
                                WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-60 days') 
                                GROUP BY user_id) 
                   GROUP BY user_id 
                   HAVING txn_count / day_count > 30);

detections.sql:
SELECT 
  t.instrument, 
  le.country, 
  COUNT(*) as total_txns, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_txns, 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 as failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t
  JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id
  JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id
WHERE 
  t.status = 'FAILED' 
  AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-60 days')
  AND u.risk_score > 70
GROUP BY 
  t.instrument, 
  le.country
HAVING 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 > 15
  AND SUM(t.amount_usd) > 200000
  AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT instrument) 
       FROM transactions 
       WHERE user_id = u.user_id 
       AND created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) >= 4
  AND (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) 
       FROM transactions 
       WHERE user_id = u.user_id 
       AND created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) * 0.3 > (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) 
       FROM transactions 
       WHERE user_id = u.user_id 
       AND created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT instrument) 
       FROM transactions 
       WHERE user_id = u.user_id 
       AND created_at >= date('now', '-90 days'))

  COUNT(DISTINCT le.device_fingerprint) AS num_devices, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT le.user_agent) AS num_user_agents, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.txn_id) AS num_transactions, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT le.event_id) AS num_login_events, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN le.device_fingerprint IN (SELECT device_fingerprint FROM login_events GROUP BY device_fingerprint HAVING COUNT(*) > 22) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_login_rate_device, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN le.user_agent IN (SELECT user_agent FROM login_events GROUP BY user_agent HAVING COUNT(*) > 22) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_login_rate_user_agent,

FROM 
  users u
  JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id

SELECT 
  UPPER(le.country) AS region, 
  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failed_count, 
  COUNT(*) AS total_count, 
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS failure_rate
FROM 
  login_events le
  JOIN transactions t ON le.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE 
  le.created_at >= date('now', '-45 days')
GROUP BY 
  UPPER(le.country), 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) > 12
  AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN t.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) > 150000
  AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') AND t.created_at < date('now', '-60 days');
